name: Byron Donalds

lean.basis: Republican in the MAGA wing of the party and a former Tea Party member; Trump-endorsed for governor.

source.title: File:Rep. Byron Donalds official photo, 117th Congress.jpg — Wikimedia Commons

current_role: Governor-elect of Florida (won November 2026); U.S. representative for Florida's 19th district since 2021
summary: Byron Donalds (born 1978) served in the Florida House from 2016 to 2020 and has represented Southwest Florida in Congress since 2021, in the MAGA wing of the Republican Party. Trump endorsed him for governor in February 2025, over Ron DeSantis's objections; he won the nomination in August 2026 and beat Democrat David Jolly in November to succeed DeSantis.

connections.description: Donalds endorsed Trump early for 2024 over DeSantis; Trump endorsed him for Florida governor in February 2025, before he had entered the race, and again in May 2026 ("Complete and Total Endorsement").
